text:
sam.devex: quick one — CI started failing for calls that use Basic auth in our Node SDK. curl locally works, pipeline fails with 401. anyone seen pipeline mangling the auth header?

maria.sdk: can you paste how you're building the header in the job (no secrets, just the code)?

sam.devex: yep. code in the pipeline step: `AUTH=\"$INFERENCE_KEY\"; HEADER=\"Basic $(echo -n $AUTH | base64)\"; curl -H \"Authorization: $HEADER\" ...` — but the value sent by curl in the runner decodes to an extra \"\r\n\" at the end. locally `echo -n` looks fine.

infra-bot: reminder: don't print secrets in logs. redact when testing. use `| sed s/./*/g` in examples if needed. :lock:

hao.platform: Azure Pipelines has two gotchas: 1) variables set via the web UI sometimes get a trailing newline if copied from a text editor; 2) Windows vs Linux hosted agents can convert newlines (CRLF).

ben.qa: also if you set the variable as a multiline or include quotes in the UI, it can add literal quotes. e.g., storing \"my:key\" vs my:key. That changes the base64.

sam.devex: hmm we store the secret in a variable group and reference `$(INFERENCE_KEY)`. I didn't add quotes. how to debug without leaking?

maria.sdk: in the job use masking and a small check that doesn't print the secret: `printf \"%s\" \"$INFERENCE_KEY\" | od -An -t x1 | head -c 32` — shows hex prefix without revealing whole key. or compare length: `printf \"%s\" \"$INFERENCE_KEY\" | wc -c` (masked value will still be redacted in logs).

sam.devex: tried `printf \"%s\" \"$INFERENCE_KEY\" | od -An -t x1` — last byte is `0d` on the runner (CR). so CRLF being appended. stack: ubuntu-latest host.

hao.platform: two fixes: strip CR/LF in the job before encoding, or base64 on the runner with `-w0` and `printf -n`. example:

```
# bash on runner
CLEAN=$(printf \"%s\" \"$INFERENCE_KEY\" | tr -d '\\r\\n')
HEADER=\"Basic $(printf \"%s\" \"$CLEAN\" | base64 -w0)\"
curl -H \"Authorization: $HEADER\" ...
```

# or (POSIX portable)
CLEAN=$(printf \"%s\" \"$INFERENCE_KEY\" | tr -d '\\r\\n')
HEADER=\"Basic $(printf \"%s\" \"$CLEAN\" | openssl base64)\"
```

maria.sdk: for Node JS steps using `process.env.INFERENCE_KEY`, do `const key = process.env.INFERENCE_KEY.replace(/\r|\n/g, '');` before `Buffer.from(key).toString('base64')`.

ben.qa: once we fixed the strip, tests passed. thumbs up from staging.

sam.devex: excellent — thanks. I'll add a tiny helper to our SDK init that normalizes env keys (strip whitespace and CRLF) and a CI lint that checks secret length in hex to avoid regressing.

infra-bot: note: adding client-side normalization is good, but we should also add a note in the internal runbooks about pipeline variable editors sometimes inserting CRLF when copying.

maria.sdk: PR incoming from @sam.devex with a one-liner and unit test. cc @hao.platform for the runbook update. :thumbsup:
